items.name: scrollspy-001
items.title: Оглавление с подсветкой
items.description: Оглавление подсвечивает раздел, видимый сейчас: слежение на IntersectionObserver, а не на обработчике прокрутки.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-scrollspy-001-*. Клиентский: "use client" ради IntersectionObserver. Наблюдатель ограничен областью текста через root, а rootMargin отрезает нижние 60%, иначе активным становится раздел, который только показался снизу. У последнего раздела есть запас снизу — без него он не долистывается.

en.description: A table of contents that highlights the section in view: tracking runs on IntersectionObserver, not a scroll handler.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-scrollspy-001-*. Client-side: "use client" for the sake of IntersectionObserver. The observer is confined to the text area through root, and rootMargin cuts off the bottom 60%, otherwise a section that has only just appeared from below becomes active. The last section has tail space beneath it — without it it never scrolls into view.

ai.summary: A table of contents with current-section highlighting: the list on the left, scrollable text on the right, a bar on the active item. Zero dependencies, one file.

IntersectionObserver instead of a scroll handler: the browser decides when to recompute
the rootMargin cutting off the bottom: otherwise a barely visible section becomes active
the tail space under the last section — without it it never scrolls into view
the bar on the active item rather than colour alone
plain links with href: the contents must work without JS too
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself
adapt: the sections array and their text
title — the contents heading
the text area height
the accent through the accent prop
background — the component background; empty means no background, taking the page colour
bodyLabel — the reading area's screen-reader label
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
The component watches its own scroll area: drop root to watch the page instead.
The highlight lags a frame on an instant jump — that is observer behaviour, not a bug.
A two-item contents list is pointless: it pays off from four sections up.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.

items.name: scrollspy-002
items.title: Оглавление статьи
items.description: Оглавление статьи стоит не сбоку, а над текстом: пункты пронумерованы, у активного номер заливается, а ряд прокручивается пальцем.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-scrollspy-002-*. Клиентский ("use client") — нужен IntersectionObserver. Наблюдатель следит за разделами внутри собственной области прокрутки: root — сам блок текста, rootMargin обрезает нижние 65%, поэтому активным становится раздел у верхней кромки, а не любой видимый. Ссылки — обычные якоря без preventDefault: без JS они по-прежнему доводят до раздела, наблюдатель добавляет только подсветку. Активный пункт помечен aria-current и залитым кружком номера: в горизонтальном ряду цвета текста мало.

en.description: An article outline placed above the text rather than beside it: the items are numbered, the active one gets a filled number, and the row scrolls by touch.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, the palette in local variables --vibeui-scrollspy-002-*. Client-side ("use client") — IntersectionObserver is needed. The observer watches the sections inside its own scroll area: root is the text block itself, rootMargin cuts off the bottom 65%, so the section at the top edge becomes active rather than any visible one. The links are plain anchors without preventDefault: without JS they still take you to the section, the observer only adds the highlight. The active item is marked with aria-current and a filled number circle: in a horizontal row the text colour alone is not enough.

ai.summary: A single-row article outline: the anchor links work without JS and an IntersectionObserver adds the current-section highlight. Zero dependencies, one file.

aria-current on the active link: a filled number is invisible to a screen reader
the bottom padding on the last section — without it it never scrolls up and never lights up
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

bodyLabel — the reading area's screen-reader label
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
Section ids must be unique on the page: two blocks with the same ids break the anchors.
A single-row outline suits five or six items: a long list turns into endless scrolling.
The reading area is local here; for a whole-page outline drop the observer's root.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.

en.title: Article Outline

sections.title: Why
sections.text: The article explains why an outline on a long page stops being decoration: readers arrive from search and land in the middle of the text.

sections.title: How it works
sections.text: Sections carry ids, the links are plain anchors, and an intersection observer adds the highlight on top of navigation that already works.

sections.title: On a phone
sections.text: A single-row outline scrolls under a thumb and takes no width from the text, so there is no need to hide it behind a button.

sections.title: Limits
sections.text: For a fifteen-item outline the row stops working: that calls for a nested list or a side column.

items.name: scrollspy-003
items.title: Вложенное оглавление
items.description: Двухуровневое оглавление, которое не вываливает сразу все подпункты: раскрыта только глава, внутри которой читатель сейчас находится.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-scrollspy-003-*. Клиентский ("use client") — нужен IntersectionObserver. Наблюдатель следит за разделами обоих уровней сразу, поэтому активным может стать и глава, и её подпункт. Раскрытие второго уровня не хранится состоянием: список показывается правилом li[data-open="true"] > [data-part="sub"], где data-open вычисляется из того, активна ли глава или любой её потомок. Ссылки — обычные якоря, подсветка идёт через aria-current на обоих уровнях.

en.description: A two-level outline that does not dump every sub-item at once: only the chapter the reader is currently inside stays expanded.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, the palette in local variables --vibeui-scrollspy-003-*. Client-side ("use client") — IntersectionObserver is needed. The observer watches the sections of both levels at once, so a chapter and its sub-item can each become active. Expansion of the second level is not held in state: the list is shown by the rule li[data-open="true"] > [data-part="sub"], where data-open is derived from whether the chapter or any of its descendants is active. The links are plain anchors, the highlight runs through aria-current on both levels.

ai.summary: A two-level outline: sub-items show only for the current chapter and the highlight covers both levels. Zero dependencies, one file.

observing both levels at once — otherwise a sub-item never becomes active

light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

items.name: scrollspy-004
items.title: Прогресс чтения
items.description: Боковое оглавление документации отвечает на два вопроса сразу: подсветка говорит «где я», а вертикальная полоса — сколько текста осталось.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-scrollspy-004-*. Клиентский ("use client") — нужны IntersectionObserver и обработчик прокрутки. en.description: A documentation sidebar that answers two questions at once: the highlight says where you are, the vertical bar says how much text is left.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, the palette in local variables --vibeui-scrollspy-004-*. Client-side ("use client") — IntersectionObserver and a scroll handler are needed. The observer finds the active section, while the read percentage is computed from the reading area's scrollTop and scrollHeight and goes into CSS through the variable --vibeui-scrollspy-004-progress: the share of the text and the section number are different quantities, because sections differ in length. The bar is marked with role="progressbar" and aria-valuenow, the links stay plain anchors.

en.title: Reading Progress

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: The documentation opens with a short explanation: what the library does and what it deliberately does not.

sections.title: Install
sections.text: One command copies the component into your project. No runtime, no configuration: the file lives in your repository and is edited like your own code.

sections.title: Theme
sections.text: Every colour is declared in the component's local variables. To recolour the block, pass a single accent variable — global styles stay untouched.

sections.title: Layout

items.name: scrollspy-005
items.title: Липкая полоса раздела
items.description: Горизонтальная панель разделов, прилипшая к верху длинной страницы: активный пункт сам доезжает до центра панели, когда уходит за край.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-scrollspy-005-*. Клиентский ("use client") — нужны IntersectionObserver и scrollIntoView. Панель липнет к верху области чтения: sticky стоит на обёртке nav, а прокручивается внутренний ul, потому что липнуть может только элемент, у родителя которого есть запас высоты. Активный пункт доводится до центра вызовом scrollIntoView({block:"nearest",inline:"center"}) — block:"nearest" обязателен, иначе браузер подтянет к центру всю страницу. Подсветка — подчёркивание псевдоэлементом плюс aria-current.

  ]}
/>

en.description: A horizontal section bar stuck to the top of a long page: the active item scrolls itself to the centre of the bar when it drifts off the edge.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, the palette in local variables --vibeui-scrollspy-005-*. Client-side ("use client") — IntersectionObserver and scrollIntoView are needed. The bar sticks to the top of the reading area: sticky sits on the nav wrapper while the inner ul is what scrolls, because only an element whose parent has spare height can stick. The active item is brought to the centre by a scrollIntoView({block:"nearest",inline:"center"}) call — block:"nearest" is mandatory, otherwise the browser pulls the whole page to the centre. The highlight is an underline drawn with a pseudo-element plus aria-current.

ai.summary: A sticky section bar that auto-centres the active item and underlines the current one. Zero dependencies, one file.

the bar's opaque background: the text below must not show through the labels
plain anchors without preventDefault: the bar must keep working without JS
aria-current on the active item: the underline is invisible to a screen reader
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

The sections' scroll-margin-top must be at least the bar height, or the anchor hides the heading behind it.
Auto-centring fires on every section change: during very fast scrolling the bar visibly shifts.

Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.
The sticky bar takes the system Canvas colour: the component has no panel of its own, yet the text must not show through the bar. The background prop recolours the bar as well.

  ]}
/>

items.name: scrollspy-006
items.title: Наверх
items.description: Оглавление с возвратом к началу: кнопка «наверх» — обычная якорная ссылка, которая прячется, пока начало текста и так на экране.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-scrollspy-006-*. Клиентский ("use client") — нужен IntersectionObserver. Наблюдателей два: первый подсвечивает активный раздел, второй следит за меткой-сентинелом в самом верху текста и прячет ссылку возврата, пока начало видно. Начальное состояние — ссылка показана, поэтому при отключённом JS она остаётся на месте и работает как обычный якорь. Прячется она атрибутом hidden, а не прозрачностью: невидимая ссылка не должна ловить фокус табом.

<Scrollspy006
  title="Содержание"
  topLabel="Наверх"
  sections={[
    { id: "intro", title: "Введение", text: "Зачем длинной странице возврат к началу" },
    { id: "usage", title: "Использование", text: "Ссылки остаются ссылками" },
  ]}
/>

en.description: An outline with a return to the top: the "back to top" button is a plain anchor link that hides itself while the start of the text is still on screen.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, the palette in local variables --vibeui-scrollspy-006-*. Client-side ("use client") — IntersectionObserver is needed. There are two observers: the first highlights the active section, the second watches a sentinel marker at the very top of the text and hides the return link while the start is visible. The initial state is the link shown, so with JS disabled it stays in place and works as a plain anchor. It is hidden with the hidden attribute rather than opacity: an invisible link must not catch focus on Tab.

ai.summary: An outline plus a return control: an anchor to the first section, hidden by an observer while the start is visible. Zero dependencies, one file.

the return as a plain anchor link: a script-only button does nothing without JS
the initial "visible" state: with JS disabled the link must stay in place
hiding with the hidden attribute rather than opacity — otherwise Tab lands on an invisible link
the separate observer on the sentinel: the link must not offer what is already done
the link floating above the reading area, not in the flow: appearing must not move the text
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

the sections through sections: id, title and text

bodyLabel — the reading area's screen-reader label
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
The sentinel is one pixel tall: zero height gives no intersection in some browsers.
The return points at the first item of sections — an empty array leaves the link without a target.
Section ids must be unique on the page.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.
The return control takes the system Canvas colour: the component has no panel of its own, yet the text must not show through the control. The background prop recolours it as well.

  topLabel="Back to top"
  sections={[
    { id: "intro", title: "Intro", text: "Why a long page needs a way back" },
    { id: "usage", title: "Usage", text: "Links stay links" },
  ]}
/>

en.title: Back To Top

sections.title: Intro
sections.text: A long text with no way back to the start forces readers to spin the wheel backwards — the most common complaint about help pages.

sections.title: Setup
sections.text: Sections are marked with ids and the outline is built from the same array as the text: they cannot drift apart.

sections.title: Usage
sections.text: Links stay links: they open in a new tab, they can be copied and sent to a colleague — the address points at the section.

sections.title: Tips
sections.text: Do not hide the return control behind an entrance animation: on a long page it is needed instantly, not half a second later.

sections.title: Wrap-up
sections.text: The outline answers "what is next", the return control answers "how do I get back". Those are different jobs.

items.name: scrollspy-007
items.title: Компактное оглавление
items.description: Одно оглавление в двух видах: широкий блок держит его колонкой слева, узкий сворачивает в раскрывающийся список с названием текущего раздела в заголовке.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-scrollspy-007-*. Клиентский ("use client") — нужны IntersectionObserver и ResizeObserver. Порог сворачивания считается от ширины самого блока, а не от ширины окна: тот же компонент может стоять в узкой колонке на большом экране. В компактном виде список живёт внутри <details>, а в заголовке summary стоит текущий раздел — свёрнутое оглавление обязано отвечать «где я». Ссылки остаются обычными якорями и закрывают список после выбора.

<Scrollspy007
  title="Содержание"
  compactAt={420}
  sections={[
    { id: "payment", title: "Оплата", text: "Платёж проходит на стороне банка" },
    { id: "refund", title: "Возврат", text: "Четырнадцать дней на возврат" },
  ]}
/>

en.description: One outline in two shapes: a wide block keeps it as a left column, a narrow one folds it into a disclosure whose summary names the current section.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, the palette in local variables --vibeui-scrollspy-007-*. Client-side ("use client") — IntersectionObserver and ResizeObserver are needed. The collapse threshold is measured against the block's own width, not the window width: the same component may sit in a narrow column on a large screen. In compact mode the list lives inside <details>, and the current section stands in the summary heading — a collapsed outline has to answer "where am I". The links stay plain anchors and close the list after a choice.

aria-current on the active link: the background fill is invisible to a screen reader
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

The threshold is in pixels, not rem: with a large system font it is worth raising.
Section ids must be unique on the page.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.

  compactAt={420}
  sections={[

  ]}
